parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token used to start the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to cluster, which indicates E-HPC clusters.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The resource tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0axxxx --resource-type cluster --resource-id ehpc-hz-xxxx --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'ehpc-hz-xxxx' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0axxxx --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType cluster --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
